deck_title: Parseval L2 quadrature wave superposition vs naive unnormalized additive variance blowout rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Marc-Antoine Parseval (1799) & Michel Plancherel (1910) L2 quadrature-normalized orthogonal wave superposition (scaling the sum of unit-variance base wave h_0 and detail wave sqrt(2u)*h_detail by 1 / sqrt(1 + 2u) across 17 detail-injection stations 2u in [0.0000, 2.0000] so spatial mean-square wave energy sigma^2 / sigma0^2 = (1 + 2u)/(1 + 2u) = 1.0000x with 0/17 inflated stations) versus naive unnormalized additive wave layering (h_0 + sqrt(2u)*h_detail, which inflates spatial wave variance as 1 + 2u to 1.5000x at u=0.25, 2.0000x at u=0.50, and 3.0000x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-point spatial domain Fourier quadrature.
